## 1. Indices and Dimensions

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $i = 1, \ldots, m$ | Subjects (clusters) |
| $j = 1, \ldots, n_i$ | Observations within subject $i$ |
| $n_i$ | Number of observations for subject $i$ |
| $N = \sum_{i=1}^{m} n_i$ | Total number of observations |
| $p$ | Number of fixed effect parameters |
| $q$ | Number of random effect parameters per subject |

## 2. Outcomes and Predictors

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $Y_{ij}$ | Outcome for subject $i$ at observation $j$ |
| $\mathbf{Y}_i$ | Response vector for subject $i$ $(n_i \times 1)$ |
| $\mathbf{Y}$ | Stacked response vector $(N \times 1)$ |
| $X_{ij}$ | Covariate vector at observation $ij$ |
| $\mathbf{X}_i$ | Design matrix for subject $i$ $(n_i \times p)$ |
| $\boldsymbol{\beta}$ | Fixed effects parameter vector $(p \times 1)$ |

## 3. Random Effects

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $\mathbf{b}_i$ | Random effects vector for subject $i$ $(q \times 1)$ |
| $b_{0i}$ | Random intercept for subject $i$ |
| $b_{1i}$ | Random slope for subject $i$ |
| $\mathbf{D}$ | Covariance matrix of random effects $(q \times q)$ |
| $\mathbf{Z}_i$ | Random effects design matrix $(n_i \times q)$ |
| $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}_i$ | Residual error vector for subject $i$ |

**Mixed Model**: $\mathbf{Y}_i = \mathbf{X}_i \boldsymbol{\beta} + \mathbf{Z}_i \mathbf{b}_i + \boldsymbol{\varepsilon}_i$, where $\mathbf{b}_i \sim N(\mathbf{0}, \mathbf{D})$ and $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}_i \sim N(\mathbf{0}, \mathbf{R}_i)$

## 4. Covariance Structures

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_i$ | Marginal covariance matrix for subject $i$ $(n_i \times n_i)$ |
| $\sigma^2$ | Residual (within-subject) variance |
| $\rho$ | Correlation parameter |
| $\tau^2$ | Between-subject variance (random intercept variance) |
| $\mathbf{R}_i$ | Residual covariance matrix |

| Structure | Formula for $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_{jk}$ |
|:----------|:---------------------------------------|
| Independence | $\sigma^2 \mathbf{I}$ |
| Compound Symmetry (CS) | $\sigma^2[(1-\rho)\mathbf{I} + \rho \mathbf{J}]$ or $\tau^2 + \sigma^2 \mathbf{I}_{j=k}$ |
| AR(1) | $\sigma^2 \rho^{|j-k|}$ |
| Unstructured (UN) | $\sigma_{jk}$ (each element estimated) |
| Toeplitz | $\sigma_{|j-k|}$ (depends only on lag) |

**Marginal Covariance**: $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_i = \mathbf{Z}_i \mathbf{D} \mathbf{Z}_i' + \mathbf{R}_i$

## 5. Estimation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $\hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}$ | Estimated fixed effects |
| $\hat{\mathbf{b}}_i$ | Predicted random effects (BLUPs) |
| $\ell(\boldsymbol{\theta})$ | Log-likelihood |
| $\boldsymbol{\theta}$ | Variance-covariance parameters |
| ML | Maximum Likelihood estimation |
| REML | Restricted Maximum Likelihood estimation |

**Key Formulas**:

- **GLS Estimator**: $\hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}} = \left( \sum_i \mathbf{X}_i' \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_i^{-1} \mathbf{X}_i \right)^{-1} \sum_i \mathbf{X}_i' \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_i^{-1} \mathbf{Y}_i$
- **Variance of** $\hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}$: $\text{Var}(\hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}) = \left( \sum_i \mathbf{X}_i' \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_i^{-1} \mathbf{X}_i \right)^{-1}$
- **BLUP**: $\hat{\mathbf{b}}_i = \mathbf{D} \mathbf{Z}_i' \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_i^{-1} (\mathbf{Y}_i - \mathbf{X}_i \hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}})$

## 6. Key Formulas Summary

| Formula | Expression |
|:--------|:-----------|
| **Rubin's Rules** (MI) | $\bar{Q} = \frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^M \hat{Q}^{(m)}$; $T = \bar{U} + (1 + \frac{1}{M})B$ |
| **Zeger Attenuation** | $\beta_{\text{marg}} \approx \beta_{\text{cond}} / \sqrt{1 + 0.346 \cdot \sigma^2_b}$ |
| **Relative Efficiency** | $\text{RE} \approx 1/(1 + (1-\rho)/n)$ for CS |
| **ICC** | $\rho = \tau^2 / (\tau^2 + \sigma^2)$ |

## 7. Link Functions (GLMMs)

| Family | Link | $g(\mu)$ | $g^{-1}(\eta)$ |
|:-------|:-----|:---------|:---------------|
| Gaussian | Identity | $\mu$ | $\eta$ |
| Binomial | Logit | $\log\left(\frac{\mu}{1-\mu}\right)$ | $\frac{e^\eta}{1+e^\eta}$ |
| Binomial | Probit | $\Phi^{-1}(\mu)$ | $\Phi(\eta)$ |
| Poisson | Log | $\log(\mu)$ | $e^\eta$ |

**GLMM**: $g(E[Y_{ij} | \mathbf{b}_i]) = \mathbf{X}_{ij}' \boldsymbol{\beta} + \mathbf{Z}_{ij}' \mathbf{b}_i$

## 8. Missing Data

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $R_{ij}$ | Missingness indicator (1 = observed, 0 = missing) |
| $\mathbf{Y}_{\text{obs}}$ | Observed outcomes |
| $\mathbf{Y}_{\text{mis}}$ | Missing outcomes |
| $M$ | Number of imputations |

| Mechanism | Definition |
|:----------|:-----------|
| **MCAR** | $P(R | Y_{\text{obs}}, Y_{\text{mis}}) = P(R)$ |
| **MAR** | $P(R | Y_{\text{obs}}, Y_{\text{mis}}) = P(R | Y_{\text{obs}})$ |
| **MNAR** | $P(R | Y_{\text{obs}}, Y_{\text{mis}})$ depends on $Y_{\text{mis}}$ |

## 9. GEE (Generalized Estimating Equations)

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $\mathbf{V}_i$ | Working covariance matrix |
| $\mathbf{R}(\boldsymbol{\alpha})$ | Working correlation matrix |
| $\boldsymbol{\alpha}$ | Correlation parameters |
| $\mathbf{A}_i$ | Diagonal matrix of variance functions |
| $\phi$ | Scale (dispersion) parameter |

**GEE Estimating Equation**:
$$\sum_{i=1}^{m} \mathbf{D}_i' \mathbf{V}_i^{-1} (\mathbf{Y}_i - \boldsymbol{\mu}_i) = \mathbf{0}$$

where $\mathbf{D}_i = \partial \boldsymbol{\mu}_i / \partial \boldsymbol{\beta}'$ and $\mathbf{V}_i = \phi \mathbf{A}_i^{1/2} \mathbf{R}(\boldsymbol{\alpha}) \mathbf{A}_i^{1/2}$

**Sandwich Variance**: $\text{Var}(\hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}) = \mathbf{B}^{-1} \mathbf{M} \mathbf{B}^{-1}$ (robust to misspecified correlation)

## 10. Test Statistics

| Statistic | Formula | Use |
|:----------|:--------|:----|
| **Wald** | $W = \hat{\beta} / \text{SE}(\hat{\beta})$ | Single parameter |
| **Wald (multivariate)** | $W = \hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}' [\text{Var}(\hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}})]^{-1} \hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}$ | Multiple parameters |
| **LRT** | $G = 2(\ell_{\text{full}} - \ell_{\text{reduced}})$ | Nested models (ML only) |
| **Score** | $U(\boldsymbol{\beta}_0)' I(\boldsymbol{\beta}_0)^{-1} U(\boldsymbol{\beta}_0)$ | Under null |

| Criterion | Formula | Use |
|:----------|:--------|:----|
| **AIC** | $-2\ell + 2k$ | Model selection |
| **BIC** | $-2\ell + k \log(N)$ | Model selection |
| **QIC** | Quasi-likelihood IC | GEE model selection |

## Quick Reference: Model Comparison

| Aspect | Mixed Model (LMM/GLMM) | GEE |
|:-------|:-----------------------|:----|
| Inference | Subject-specific (conditional) | Population-averaged (marginal) |
| Likelihood | Full likelihood | Quasi-likelihood |
| Correlation | Part of model | "Working" (nuisance) |
| Missing data | Valid under MAR | Valid under MCAR |
| Random effects | Estimated | Not estimated |
